# azure-functions-cookbook-python — Full LLM Reference

> Practical recipes and examples for Azure Functions Python v2.

## Package Info

- Repository: https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-cookbook-python
- Version: 0.4.0 <!-- x-release-please-version -->
- Python: >=3.11, <3.15
- License: MIT
- Docs: https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/
- Azure Functions programming model: v2

## What It Provides

This repository is a content-first cookbook for Azure Functions Python v2. It provides pattern pages under
`docs/patterns/` and matching runnable example projects under `examples/`, covering common trigger types
and architecture patterns. It is not a runtime package with a public API surface.

## How To Use This Cookbook

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-cookbook-python.git
cd azure-functions-cookbook-python
make install
make check-all
```

Use this flow:

1. Pick a scenario from the recipe inventory below.
2. Read the pattern page in `docs/patterns/<category>/<slug>.md`.
3. Run and adapt the matching project in `examples/<category>/<name>/`.

## Trigger Patterns Covered

- HTTP
- Timer
- Queue
- Blob
- Event Grid
- Service Bus
- Event Hub
- Cosmos DB
- Durable Functions

## Full Recipe Inventory

81 published recipes across 14 categories. Each row maps a pattern page
(`docs/patterns/<category>/<slug>.md`) to its runnable example project. The same inventory is
available as machine-readable JSON in `recipes.json`, regenerated with
`python scripts/gen_recipe_index.py`.

| Recipe | Difficulty | Example path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Multi-Tenant Auth | Intermediate | `examples/apis-and-ingress/auth_multitenant` | Multi-tenant access control with tenant allowlist for Azure Functions. |
| BFF Facade API | Intermediate | `examples/apis-and-ingress/bff_facade_api` | HTTP Backend-for-Frontend facade that aggregates multiple backend service calls into one client-facing response. |
| Full Stack CRUD API | Advanced | `examples/apis-and-ingress/full_stack_crud_api` | Showcase HTTP API that wires the Azure Functions Python DX Toolkit together around one `items` resource. |
| Hello HTTP Minimal | Beginner | `examples/apis-and-ingress/hello_http_minimal` | Minimal HTTP-triggered Azure Function that returns a greeting. |
| HTTP Auth Levels | Beginner | `examples/apis-and-ingress/http_auth_levels` | HTTP trigger example that demonstrates anonymous, function-key, and admin-key endpoints. |
| HTTP Routing Query Body | Beginner | `examples/apis-and-ingress/http_routing_query_body` | HTTP CRUD and search example showing route params, query strings, JSON body parsing, and status codes. |
| OpenAPI Return-Type Inference | Intermediate | `examples/apis-and-ingress/openapi_inference` | Infer the OpenAPI 200 response schema directly from a handler's return-type annotation using azure-functions-openapi. |
| OpenAPI Return-Type Inference Opt-Out | Intermediate | `examples/apis-and-ingress/openapi_inference_opt_out` | Opt out of inferred OpenAPI 200 response schemas per handler with infer_return_types=False. |
| OpenAPI Validation Supersedes Inference | Intermediate | `examples/apis-and-ingress/openapi_supersedes` | Show how a validation response_model supersedes the return-type-inferred OpenAPI 200 schema. |
| scaffold_walkthrough_app | Beginner | `examples/apis-and-ingress/scaffold_walkthrough_app` | This recipe is the **committed output of `azure-functions-scaffold`** with the default `strict` preset. Use it to see exactly what the scaffold CLI generates for a fresh Azure Functions Python v2 HTTP project and to learn the recommended local dev loop. |
| Webhook GitHub | Intermediate | `examples/apis-and-ingress/webhook_github` | GitHub webhook receiver example with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. |

## Repository Layout

```text
docs/patterns/<category>/<slug>.md   Pattern pages (81 published recipes)
examples/<category>/<name>/          Matching runnable example projects
recipes.json                         Machine-readable recipe index
scripts/                             Index and requirements generators
src/                                 Package metadata only (no runtime API)
tests/                               Consistency, smoke, and e2e guards
```

Categories (shared by `docs/patterns/` and `examples/`): `apis-and-ingress`,
`scheduled-and-background`, `blob-and-file-triggers`, `async-apis-and-jobs`, `messaging-and-pubsub`,
`streams-and-telemetry`, `data-and-pipelines`, `orchestration-and-workflows`, `reliability`,
`security-and-tenancy`, `runtime-and-ops`, `realtime`, `ai-and-agents`, `guides`.

## Development Commands

```bash
make install
make check-all
make docs
```

## Design Principles

From `DESIGN.md`:

1. Start from a developer problem, not from a library feature.
2. Keep recipes focused on one use case and one architectural story.
3. Pair each recipe with an example that can evolve into a scaffold starter later.
4. Preserve independence from the other repositories at the documentation level.

## Product Requirements Highlights

From `PRD.md`:

- Goal: help developers discover and start real Azure Functions Python solutions through curated recipes.
- Core value per recipe: what to build, what architecture to use, and how to start from a working baseline.
- Example-first philosophy: recipes should get developers from zero to a running function quickly.
- This repository is a cookbook with runnable examples, not a standalone runtime API package.

## Documentation

- Product requirements: `PRD.md`
- Design principles: `DESIGN.md`
- Contributing guide: `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- Published docs: https://yeongseon.dev/azure-functions-python/cookbook/

## Ecosystem Integration

Part of **Azure Functions Python DX Toolkit**:

| Package | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [azure-functions-openapi-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-openapi-python) | OpenAPI spec generation and Swagger UI |
| [azure-functions-validation-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-validation-python) | Request/response validation and serialization |
| [azure-functions-db-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-db-python) | Database bindings for SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Cosmos DB |
| [azure-functions-langgraph-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-langgraph-python) | LangGraph deployment adapter for Azure Functions |
| [azure-functions-scaffold-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-scaffold-python) | Project scaffolding CLI |
| [azure-functions-logging-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-logging-python) | Structured logging and observability |
| [azure-functions-doctor-python](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-doctor-python) | Pre-deploy diagnostic CLI |
| **azure-functions-cookbook-python** | Recipes and examples |
